capabilities.name: Message another AI agent
capabilities.description: Ask another AI agent of this organisation for something, in a conversation a person started. Answering when asked needs no permission.

to.description: the identifier of the AI agent to ask

capabilities.name: Make machines for other AI agents
capabilities.description: Make a new machine for another AI agent of this organisation when a person asks, providing what that AI agent's work needs, and destroy it when a person removes it. The new machine still enrols with a one-time string, and a person approves its six words before it speaks as that AI agent.

provides.description: what the machines it makes can provide
